ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: "Arabic-English Translation" this is an intensive course in Arabic to English translation that introduces the learners to translation methods, with particular reference to the development of Arabic-English translation techniques and the acquisition of such knowledge above and beyond language skills. The course will meet for 3 hours per day, three days per week for a total of 8 weeks, and will involve practical translation work daily. The successful participants will earn one semester's worth of credit and a certificate. Pre-requisite: Advanced standing in Arabic.
